name: refundPayment
description: Refund a completed payment for an order. amount is a decimal string matching the amount originally taken, for example "49.99". Returns the order id, the decimal amount and the resulting payment status.

orderId.description: The order id, for example O-9001.

amount.description: The amount to refund, as a decimal string, for example 49.99.

name: takePayment
description: Take a payment for an order. amount is a decimal string, for example "49.99". Returns the order id, the decimal amount taken and the resulting payment status.

orderId.description: The order id, for example O-9001.

amount.description: The amount to take, as a decimal string, for example 49.99.
